name: Physical runtime boundary bridge with evidence-preserving improvement loop
trigger: Host automation is complete or host-qualified, but authentic Android/Termux execution is still required for a physical gate, device-local action, or device-origin evidence.
standing_rule: Do not stop at the host/device boundary and do not fabricate physical execution. Reuse this bridge pattern: host preflight -> same-script Termux handoff -> verified component reuse -> local ADB reconnect -> bounded improvement cycle -> device evidence capture -> independent controller verification.
authority_boundary: First-time Android pairing, physical reboot, provider consent, credentials, and other owner-controlled or provider-controlled actions remain external authorization/physical boundaries. The bridge reduces them but does not bypass them.
reuse_policy: For future similar blockers, search for and reuse this pattern and its registered ability before designing a new physical-boundary workflow.
